name: balik-ciftligi-frontend
description: Sources of the browser code: the TypeScript, compiled into static/js (not committed), the islands (React, frontend/islands, built by Vite into static/islands, not committed), the design tokens (docs/design/system/tokens.json, built into tokens.css, committed) and the Tailwind source, built into static/css/tw.css (committed).

scripts.build: node scripts/tokens.mjs && node scripts/icons.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/islands.mjs && node scripts/tailwind.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/islands.mjs --gallery && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/mark-esm.mjs && node --test ".build/test/**/*.test.js"
